subject: Restart daemon to apply taskTranscript fix
description: The daemon.js fix to attribute inline main-agent work on claimed tasks to the mainTranscript (instead of counting it as trapped) requires a daemon restart to take effect. Restart the orchestrator daemon at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid so the updated taskTranscript function is loaded. After restart, verify with: curl -s http://localhost:8787/costflow | node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'); const j=JSON.parse(d); console.log('trapped:', j.totals.trapped, 'productive:', j.totals.productive);"
